name: grow-train-set
description: Grow the tutor training set (authored + gold pairs + consented class sessions) and write needs_data.json for subjects under the 40% floor. CPU only; the frontier bottleneck is data, not GPU. Kal-el or Mac. Output: output/kalel/data/sessions.grown.json (rsync to Spark via sync_kalel_to_spark.sh).
